value_metrics: TTM net income / equity market capitalization
TTM operating cash flow / equity market capitalization
value_ranking: mean of two percentile ranks within the original five industry subgroups; ties use average rank
quality_and_momentum: unchanged from industry18_protocol.json; global eligible-universe percentile ranks
eligibility: identical pool for all four variants: original QM eligibility plus positive disclosed ordinary share count aged <=550 days and available historical FX; QV also retains the original momentum warmup
execution: first window close and subsequent calendar month-end close signals; next session open fills; select 5, maximum 2 per subgroup, target 20% each; unfilled slots remain cash
shares: latest observation date visible strictly before signal day; DEI preferred at equal observation date, otherwise US-GAAP/IFRS; latest visible revision; non-DEI figures normalized from filing-date split basis to observation-date basis
market_cap: nominal USD close * split-normalized disclosed ordinary shares / ADR ratio, converted to reporting currency using last FX observation strictly before signal date, at most 7 calendar days old
corporate_actions: restore nominal historical close using subsequent Yahoo split adjustments; adjust outstanding shares only for genuine stock splits; WDC 2025-02-24 ratio 1.323 is a spinoff price adjustment, not a share-count split
costs: initial USD100000; one-way fee5bps and slippage5bps; terminal liquidation costs; stress fee10bps and slippage20bps
limitations: retrospectively selected AI-chain stock universe; selection/survivorship bias
historical comparison, not an untouched out-of-sample test
sparse subgroup rankings (3-4 members) and correlated factors
latest disclosed share-count market-cap proxy, not exact daily market capitalization
OCF yield is not free-cash-flow yield; capital expenditure not deducted
GAAP/IFRS earnings and cash flow are not cleaned for nonrecurring items
SNDK not eligible until 2026-02-25 due to momentum warmup
WDC spinoff return uses inherited adjusted-price approximation, not actual distributed SNDK holdings
research next-open execution differs from the live automation next-close convention
no taxes, borrow costs or cash interest; no market-timing overlay
